Messages.Author: Legbiter
Messages.Body:
As i've said before, i'm not a GREAT fan of ALL the texts in Bloodlines. Most
of the weirdnesses don't have any forseeable effect on game-play, but as i gird
my loins to build my first Samedi deck there is one text which is bothering me
more and more.

Infection [BL]
Cardtype: Combat
Cost:2 blood
Discipline:Thanatosis/Fortitude
[for] Prevent all damage from the opponent's strikes this round.
[thn] Prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or retainer) in combat. Usable by a
vampire not involved in the combat.
[THN] Only usable at the end of a round in which this vampire successfully
inflicted damage on the opposing vampire. Put this card on the opposing
vampire. The vampire with this card cannot block the vampire playing this card.

It's the inferior Thanatosis text which i'm worried about. Shouldn't this say
IN A ROUND OF COMBAT, or FROM AN OPPONENT'S STRIKES IN COMBAT, or something? Or
can one really rush with the Arms Dealer, trap, play Infection at superior
thanatosis and then lucky blow every third round until one's opponent strikes
to end combat or falls over? That seems a LITTLE bit powerful to me, since the
only other way to do something similar [Memories of Mortality] costs a master
phase and a pool, and targets a single vampire [not an ally]. Forgive me if
this has already been ruled upon, but i have done the appropriate Google search
and found nothing pertinent.

--

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
"Legbiter" <legb...@mailandnews.com> wrote in
news:a353186db23b16a6a57...@mygate.mailgate.org:



I believe this should be read: "Prevent all damage >>being currently
applied<< to a ghoul in combat".
That is, you can prevent all damage during a given strike resolution, but
it won't prevent any damage in other strike resolutions, or at any other
time. All cards that do so (ie, Skin of Steel) say it explicitly, by
default you can't 'save' your prevention points. Treat it like a Hidden
Strength where X is all damage being applied to the minion.

Flux

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <a353186db23b16a6a57...@mygate.mailgate.org>,

Legbiter <legb...@mailandnews.com> writes:
>[for] Prevent all damage from the opponent's strikes this round.
>[thn] Prevent all damage to a ghoul (ally or retainer) in combat. Usable by a
>vampire not involved in the combat.
>[THN] Only usable at the end of a round in which this vampire successfully
>inflicted damage on the opposing vampire. Put this card on the opposing
>vampire. The vampire with this card cannot block the vampire playing this card.
>
>It's the inferior Thanatosis text which i'm worried about. Shouldn't this say
>IN A ROUND OF COMBAT, or FROM AN OPPONENT'S STRIKES IN COMBAT, or something?

As with most such "Prevent .... damage" cards, it only applies to damage
currently being handled.

Skin of Rock, for instance, says "Prevent 2 damage" - it doesn't hang
around, however, even if you've only prevented one damage.

--
